interpretation: Descriptive paired rescore only; it does not create or alter an acceptance gate.

formula.position_Q: sqrt(mean_t(sum_xyz((state_position - reference_position)^2))) over all 20,001 logged state samples from 0 to 20 s.
formula.attitude_SO3: sqrt(mean_k(theta_k^2)) over 20,000 transitions; theta=atan2(0.5*norm(vee(Rd^T R - R^T Rd)), clip((trace(Rd^T R)-1)/2,-1,1)); R uses the logged ZYX Euler convention.
formula.pair_delta: candidate minus same-scene locked B72. For position Q, |delta|<=1e-12 m is a tie; otherwise lower is a win. For SO(3), exact equality is a tie; otherwise lower is a win. All values use unrounded RMSEs.
formula.group_macro: Unweighted arithmetic mean of per-scene RMSEs and per-scene paired deltas within each group; time samples are not treated as independent scenes.
formula.safety_counts: Per-transition any-axis counts from raw motor_saturated and generalized_clipped arrays; tilt_limited counts nonzero transitions; stop/status text is copied from raw/status records.

unresolved_items: The reused T2 candidate run_status remains FAILED_ENGINEERING; the prior independent review attributes that label to the former trace-shape checker. This rescore preserves the status label and reports raw metrics without rewriting it.
Historical reused status files have differing schemas; missing historical TEST/training fields are not inferred from the raw. Their provenance remains the locked source/review records.
The scorer verifies C5-locked B72 file hashes and exact same-scene raw input arrays. It does not rebuild all scene payloads from source CSVs or re-audit the full 20,000-sample observer causal traces.
The B lineage review records historical_72_runtime_tree_gap_closed=false while closing per-scene C5 B72 raw/status lineage; retain both statements with their original scopes.
